title: Novartis’ Lp(a) drug shows zero benefit, casting shadow over Amgen and Lilly programs
summary: Novartis has lifted the lid on data from its failed cardiovascular outcomes trial, reporting a total absence of efficacy that could intensify questions about upcoming readouts from Amgen and Eli Lilly.

title: Chutes & Ladders—Novo's longtime CFO to hang up gloves as Galderma exec steps in
summary: Novo's CFO of the past 8 years is taking his leave at the end of the year. Alnylam is on the hunt for a new commercial chief amid news of Tolga Tanguler's departure. Amgen has looked within to replace its head of quality.

title: There's more than one way to build a biotech
summary: Axiom Biosciences is taking an unconventional approach to raising capital and developing new therapies. In this episode of "The Top Line," founder and CEO Remo Moomiaie-Qajar joins Fierce Biotech's Marissa Russo to discuss the company's financing strategy, drug development approach and upcoming clinical milestones.

title: Generate CEO sees ‘huge opportunity’ from using Claude to shorten CAR-T cell engines
summary: Generate Biomedicines' CEO has hailed the “huge opportunity” offered by AI tools after the Flagship-founded company used Anthropic's Claude AI platform to reduce the size of CAR-T cell engines.

title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
summary: Moderna has scrapped plans to enroll a new cohort in a phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine and instead will meet with regulators to decide on next steps.

title: Merck abandons Sutro-partnered IL-2 drug in ‘routine pipeline prioritization’
summary: Merck & Co. has called time on a Sutro Biopharma-partnered IL-2 agonist that was being tested for solid tumors.

title: Siemens Healthineers rebrands and carves out in vitro diagnostics biz
summary: Siemens Healthineers will carve out its in vitro diagnostics business as a standalone company operating under the name Olyrian Diagnostics.

title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
summary: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

title: MetaVia sees GLP-1 shed liver fat and body weight in phase 1, takes aim at specific liver disease
summary: MetaVia has linked its GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist to reductions in liver fat and body weight in a phase 1 trial. Encouraged by the data, MetaVia plans to start a phase 2 trial in alcohol-associated liver disease next year.

title: AstraZeneca said to offer $10B to acquire Rhythm, analysts whisper of a bidding war
summary: AstraZeneca has made a roughly $10 billion offer to purchase rare obesity disease player Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, The Wall Street Journal reports. At least three teams of analysts suggest a bidding war could be brewing and that Rhythm is unlikely to settle for AZ’s current pitch.

title: Agios aims to shed over 100 R&D roles this year ahead of hoped-for sickle cell disease approval
summary: Agios Pharmaceuticals has been shrinking its R&D headcount over the course of 2026 as the commercial-stage company looks to eliminate more than 100 roles by year-end.

title: Cash-strapped Vivoryon regains China rights to kidney disease prospect from Simcere
summary: Vivoryon Therapeutics has regained the China rights to its kidney disease prospect as the German biotech’s cash reserves begin to dry up.

title: Evommune signs $1B deal with China’s Hinova to enter same molecular glue niche as Novartis
summary: Evommune has paid $30 million to China’s Hinova Pharmaceuticals to get stuck into a niche of preclinical molecular glue degrader development that’s also being pursued by Novartis.

title: T-Therapeutics raises $133M series B for bispecific pipeline with Big Pharma backers in tow
summary: T-Therapeutics has pulled in a $133 million series B financing round that will be used to fund the biotech’s lineup of T cell receptor CD3 bispecific drug candidates.

title: Cloudbreak posts phase 3 eye disease win amid IPO storm
summary: A phase 3 study of Cloudbreak Pharma’s eye disease drug candidate has hit its co-primary endpoints, boosting a biotech embroiled in an IPO investigation.

title: Charles River teams up with Ipsen to use virtual control groups in toxicology studies
summary: Charles River Laboratories’ virtual control group (VCG) database will be used in a toxicology study run by French biopharma company Ipsen.

title: Madrigal’s former clinical development head files whistleblower lawsuit alleging Rezdiffra safety cover-up
summary: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is facing a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that senior leadership censored serious liver-injury data related to its breakthrough MASH drug Rezdiffra and retaliated against the firm’s top clinical development head who tried to sound the alarm.

title: Smith+Nephew held failed talks with J&J over potential orthopedics combination
summary: Smith+Nephew held talks with Johnson & Johnson’s hip-and-knee replacement unit DePuy Synthes aimed at a potential combination with its orthopedics unit.

title: Minghui grants ASKA Japanese rights to sub-q TED candidate in $440M deal
summary: China’s Minghui Pharmaceutical has licensed its late-stage thyroid eye disease candidate to ASKA Pharmaceutical for up to $440 million, granting the Japanese drugmaker exclusive development and commercialization rights in its home country.

title: Blackstone Life Sciences teams up with Boston Scientific in $455M heart pump deal
summary: Blackstone Life Sciences has penned a $455 million collaboration with Boston Scientific to co-fund the development of the medtech’s next-generation miniature heart pump system.

title: Boehringer returns to Sino Biopharma in $7.4B deal for preclinical TCEs, ADCs
summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has returned to China to satisfy its appetite for antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers.

title: nPhase rakes in $30M to expand AI-native clinical data platform
summary: Clinical research company nPhase has closed a $30 million series D financing round to expand its AI-native clinical data platform.

title: AbbVie pens $1.4B deal for deprioritized IBD drug from Nxera
summary: AbbVie has added another angle to its relationship with Nxera, with the Big Pharma paying $100 million upfront for a phase 1 inflammatory bowel disease candidate.
